blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A total of 19 applicants are vying for a Supreme Court post that will be vacated on Nov. 16 upon the compulsory retirement of Associate Justice Amy Lazaro-Javier. The Judicial and Bar Council (JBC) will interview the 19 applicants starting Oct. 13. Of the 19 applicants, the JBC will interview eight, while it will skip interviews for the other 11 because their previous interviews for vacancies remain valid.
